description: Portable mcpServers shape — every harness consumes some flavor of this. Keyed by platform to allow selective install.

ios-simulator._notes: joshuayoes/ios-simulator-mcp — taps, screenshots, accessibility queries. Requires Facebook IDB: brew install idb-companion

xcodebuild._notes: cameroncooke/XcodeBuildMCP — build, install, launch, recordVideo, log capture

mobile-mcp._notes: mobile-next/mobile-mcp — cross-platform iOS + Android, sim/emu/real device. Accessibility snapshots or coordinate taps.

chrome-devtools._notes: ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp — Web Vitals, console, network, CPU emulation

platforms._note: Default MCP registrations per platform. Mobile platforms install no MCPs by default — agent-device (a CLI) is the primary tool. Web installs Playwright + Chrome DevTools by default because they complement agent-browser with cross-browser support and perf diagnostics; they are not redundant with agent-browser.

fallback_mcps._note: Fallback MCPs — register only if `agent-device` is unavailable. install.sh does NOT register these by default; users opt in by registering them manually (see adapters/<harness>/README.md) or by setting INSTALL_FALLBACK_MCPS=1 before running install.sh.

cli_tools._note: Primary tools per platform. The installer always tries these first.
